pages.textPreview: Category Accuracy Accuracy scores are not a reflection of every review you have completed. Our system calculates accuracy by sampling a fraction of your reviews from the past 14 days. These reviews are selected at random and audited for accuracy. The accuracy scores shown below are based on those audits.
